name: ogtrade
caption:
THE OG TRADE 🎮🏀 We sent OG Anunoby to New York for RJ and IQ. Who won?

• Dec 30, 2023: OG goes to the Knicks, RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley come to us
• RJ this season: 21.6 PPG, 6.1 RPG
• IQ this season: 17.4 PPG, 5.8 APG
• OG this season: 16.4 PPG, 38.0 FG%

Who won the trade? 👇

beats.head: THE TRADE
beats.name: OG
beats.vo: We traded OG Anunoby to New York for RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley. Did we win that trade?
beats.dlg: WE TRADE OG TO NEW YORK...|FOR RJ AND IQ.

beats.head: RJ BARRETT
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: RJ this season: twenty-one point six points and six rebounds a night.

beats.head: IMMANUEL QUICKLEY
beats.name: IQ
beats.vo: Immanuel Quickley: seventeen point four points and almost six assists.

beats.head: OG IN NEW YORK
beats.name: OG
beats.vo: And OG in New York? Sixteen point four a night, shooting thirty-eight percent.

beats.head: WHO WON?
beats.vo: Two for one. Who won the trade? Comment below.
beats.dlg: TWO FOR ONE.|WHO WON THE TRADE?

facts.claim: On 30 December 2023 the Raptors traded Anunoby (with Achiuwa and Flynn) to the Knicks for RJ Barrett, Immanuel Quickley and a second-round pick: 2 players for 1 star
